title: Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf Season 2 to Debut in January
content: The staff for the second season of the Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf anime unveiled on Wednesday the anime's key visual and January premiere on TV Tokyo and other channels.
author: ANN

title: New Votoms Anime Films Stream 1st 9 Minutes
content: The staff for Sunrise and Production I.G 's Sōkō Kihei Votoms Haiiro no Hexe ( Armored Trooper Votoms : Die Graue Hexe or literally, Armored Trooper Votoms : The Grey Witch), the two new anime films in the Armored Trooper Votoms franchise , started streaming the first film's first nine minutes on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Identity V Game's Oha Suta Daigo Gakuen Short Anime Unveils More Cast, Staff, November 24 Debut
content: The staff for the Oha Suta children's variety show announced on Tuesday the episode titles, main cast and staff members, and the November 24 premiere for the Oha Suta Daigo Gakuen (Good Morning Studio: V Academy) anime .

title: 4 More Anime Still Coming to Netflix in 2026
content: 2026 is heading towards the final month of the year, as the Fall 2026 anime season will wrap up along with the year. The final quarter of the year began last month, when all major platforms released exciting new shows for fans worldwide.
author: ComicBook

title: Naruto’s Creator Has the Chance to Redeem Himself From His Biggest Failure
content: While fans hope Naruto ’s new manga will focus on Naruto and Team 7, it might be about the next generation instead. Ever since the original creator announced Naruto’ s new manga at the recent New York Comic Con, fans have naturally been looking forward to seeing what Kishimoto has planned for the beloved original…

title: Yaiba: Samurai Legend Season 2 Reveals Cast Member Yūma Uchida, Opening Song Artists
content: The official website for the second season of Yaiba: Samurai Legend ( Shin Samurai-den YAIBA ), the new television anime of Detective Conan creator Gōshō Aoyama 's Yaiba manga, announced on Wednesday that it has cast Yūma Uchida as Gekkō (seen below).

title: Demon Slayer’s Infinity Castle Future Faces a Major Problem
content: Demon Slayer recently released the first installment of its Infinity Castle trilogy in U.S. theaters, and it’s already smashing box office records . The film commences the highly anticipated showdown between the Demon Slayer Corps and the demons.

title: Otherworldly Munchkin Anime's New Video Reveals More Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, January 7 Debut

title: 'Sakamoto Days 2nd Season' Unveils Additional Cast, Opening Theme, First Promo
content: The official website of the Sakamoto Days television anime unveiled a pair of additional cast, key visual (pictured), the opening theme, and first promotional video for the second season on Wednesday.
